name: MaloMyotismon
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] By deleting 1 of your Digimon or Tamers, delete 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon. If this effect didn't delete an opponent's Digimon, delete 1 of their Tamers.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When an effect deletes one of your other Digimon or Tamers, trash the top card of your opponent's security stack.
